c59bfcc2373bcbda.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة راضي أحمد المنهالي وأولاده للتجارة والمقاولات عن مهندس مدني للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية الإشراف الهندسي على المشاريع الإنشائية، بدءاً من دراسة الموقع ووصولاً إلى متابعة التنفيذ وضمان مطابقة المواصفات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة طبوغرافية وجيولوجية الموقع الإنشائي وتحليل نتائج اختبار فحص التربة. دراسة المتطلبات والمخططات المعمارية للمشروع لتحديد الجدوى الإنشائية. تحديد أعماق التأسيس اللازمة للمشروع وإجراء تحليل إنشائي متكامل لعناصره. إعداد التصاميم الإنشائية للمشروع ومتابعة إعداد المخططات الإنشائية وتدقيقها. تدقيق جداول الكميات والمواصفات للمواد الإنشائية المستخدمة في المشروع. الإشراف المباشر على تنفيذ المشروع في الموقع لضمان مطابقة المواصفات والمعايير الهندسية. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل الهندسية ومواكبة التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية، بما في ذلك نسبة التقدم، وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة شهادة جامعية في الهندسة المدنية. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال الهندسة المدنية والمشاريع الإنشائية. معرفة قوية بأسس التصميم الإنشائي وتحليل التربة. القدرة على قراءة وتدقيق المخططات وجداول الكميات. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في الإشراف على المشاريع وإدارة المواقع. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية والوثائق الهندسية. مهارات تواصل فعالة والقدرة على العمل ضمن فريق. الالتزام بالمعايير الهندسية والجودة. نوع العمل ومكان الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في المنطقة الشرقية. الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات. التقديم ندعو المهندسين المدنيين ذوي الخبرة للتقدم لهذه الفرصة والانضمام إلى فريق عمل راضي أحمد المنهالي وأولاده للتجارة والمقاولات.

c53ae89d154ee803.description: About the Role RAWAJ is seeking a Finance Director – Manufacturing & Building Materials to join its team in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is based in either Jeddah or Yanbu and involves leading the finance function for a global manufacturer of building materials. The Finance Director will support operational expansion and manufacturing initiatives within the Kingdom. Role Purpose and Context The Finance Director will be responsible for driving financial strategy, business performance, governance, and operational efficiency across Saudi Arabian operations. This position acts as a strategic business partner to country leadership, providing essential financial insights to inform business decisions, investment opportunities, and sustainable growth, while ensuring robust financial controls and compliance with both local and Group requirements. Key Responsibilities Lead financial strategy and planning for KSA, ensuring alignment with GCC and Group objectives. Act as a strategic business partner to the KSA leadership team, providing financial insights and recommendations for business decisions and growth. Oversee annual budgeting, periodic forecasting, long-range financial planning, and performance management. Manage financial reporting, accounting operations, and month-end, quarter-end, and year-end closing processes. Ensure accuracy and transparency of financial information across all KSA operations and legal entities. Establish and maintain strong internal controls, financial governance, and risk management frameworks. Ensure compliance with Saudi Arabia's statutory, tax, Zakat, VAT, and regulatory requirements. Oversee treasury, cash flow management, liquidity planning, and working capital optimization. Partner with commercial, manufacturing, supply chain, and operational teams to improve profitability, cost efficiency, and financial performance. Evaluate business expansion opportunities, capital expenditure, investments, pricing strategies, and commercial initiatives. Drive finance transformation through ERP governance, process standardization, automation, and continuous improvement. Lead, develop, and strengthen the KSA finance team, establishing clear objectives, performance KPIs, and succession plans. Manage relationships with senior leadership, external auditors, financial advisers, banks, and relevant regulatory authorities. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in finance leadership roles. Demonstrated ability to lead financial strategy and operations within a manufacturing or building materials context. Strong understanding of financial controls, compliance, and risk management. Experience with annual budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning. Work Environment This is a full-time position within a leading global manufacturer of building materials. The role requires collaboration with various internal teams and external stakeholders, operating in a dynamic environment focused on operational expansion and manufacturing initiatives in Saudi Arabia. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

c53e80595602cf76.description: About the Role HanmiGlobal Saudi is seeking a Senior Mechanical Engineer with a strong irrigation background to join our client-side programme and construction management (PMCM) team. This full-time position is based in Riyadh and involves working on a major government land-development and infrastructure programme. The role focuses on overseeing irrigation and pumping systems within an assigned package, covering design review, site supervision, and testing through to handover. Programme Context The programme involves a Lead Developer responsible for designing and building extensive infrastructure, including roads, water, sewer, storm drainage, power, street lighting, irrigation, landscape, and telecom. Our team is tasked with reviewing, supervising, and accepting this work on behalf of the client. The Senior Mechanical Engineer will specifically manage the irrigation and pumping systems that serve the programme's parks, streetscapes, and public realm, ensuring compliance with client standards and specifications. Key Responsibilities Review irrigation and mechanical design submissions, including hydraulic and water-demand calculations, drawings, shop drawings, and material submittals for irrigation networks, pump stations, pipelines, valves, filtration, and control systems. Ensure compliance of all submissions with approved specifications and client standards. Supervise and inspect irrigation and mechanical works on site, verifying adherence to approved drawings, specifications, and quality procedures. Witness and verify testing and commissioning activities, such as hydrostatic pressure tests for pipelines, pump operational and performance tests, network flushing, and commissioning of controllers and central control systems. Ensure that any failed tests are promptly corrected and re-tested. Process and track Work and Material Inspection Requests (WIRs/MIRs), and raise and follow up Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) for the discipline. Review water-supply, Treated Sewage Effluent (TSE), storage, and pumping provisions, providing feedback on maintainability, sustainability, and life-cycle performance. Support value engineering and constructability reviews. Coordinate interfaces with landscape, water, drainage, and electrical disciplines, as well as with utility providers regarding connections, tie-ins, and authority witnessing. Review close-out deliverables, including as-built drawings, O&M manuals and plans, warranty certificates, spare-parts lists, and commissioning certificates. Witness the contractor’s training of operations staff on the irrigation systems. Guide package Mechanical and Irrigation Inspectors and contribute to progress reports and site meetings. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience as a Mechanical Engineer. Demonstrated strong background and expertise in irrigation systems. Experience in design review, site supervision, and testing and commissioning processes. Ability to coordinate effectively with multiple disciplines and external stakeholders. Work Environment The successful candidate will work as part of a client-side programme and construction management team, collaborating closely with various engineering disciplines, developer contractors, and relevant utility authorities. The role requires a presence on-site to supervise and inspect works, ensuring project quality and compliance.

c567d8edbdfed72b.description: About Sophos Sophos is a global leader in cybersecurity, providing AI-driven platforms and expert-led services to protect over 600,000 organizations worldwide. The company's solutions integrate machine learning, automation, and real-time threat intelligence with human expertise from Sophos X-Ops, delivering advanced 24/7 threat monitoring, detection, and response. Sophos offers managed detection and response (MDR) alongside a comprehensive portfolio of cybersecurity technologies, including endpoint, network, email, cloud security, extended detection and response (XDR), identity threat detection and response (ITDR), and next-gen SIEM. Headquartered in Oxford, *, Sophos operates through a global partner ecosystem. The Role of (Pre-) Solutions Engineer Sophos is seeking a (Pre-) Solutions Engineer to support its operations in Saudi Arabia and Pakistan. This full-time role involves managing all technical aspects of supporting distribution partners and key accounts. The Solutions Engineer will be responsible for determining technical requirements and ensuring the success of product trials and evaluations. The position requires 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. Key Responsibilities Review partner opportunities, assessing their size, value, and technical complexity, and allocate appropriate systems engineering resources. Plan and prepare presentations to detail the technical elements of customer solutions. Conduct technical demonstrations for partners using specialized software and tools. Develop strong working relationships with technical staff at key partner organizations. Present at various events as a keynote speaker to promote Sophos in the region. Deliver product training sessions and webinars for partner engineers. Communicate regional technical feature requests to the product development team. Assist partners in drafting technical RFPs. Required Qualifications and Experience Experience as a technical support specialist, systems engineer, or security consultant. Solid experience with networking devices such as firewalls, proxies, VPN gateways, or UTMs. Proficiency in endpoint and gateway security, covering both threat and data protection. Demonstrated ability to present complex technical solutions to both technical and non-technical audiences. A strong technical background in networking and/or security applications. Experience working with and supporting channel partners and customers. Systems administration experience with Windows, Linux, UNIX, Novell, or macOS. Willingness to undertake substantial travel to support partners and attend international conferences and training. Work Environment Sophos supports flexible working arrangements, with many roles offered remotely or in a hybrid model. For remote positions, candidates are expected to reside in and be authorized to work in the specified location, which for this role is Saudi Arabia. Teams collaborate across various locations and time zones, utilizing technology to maintain connectivity and achieve results. Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion Sophos values diverse experiences, perspectives, and backgrounds, believing that varied thinking fosters innovative ideas. The company is committed to building an inclusive workplace where individuals can contribute, grow, and succeed. All candidates are evaluated based on job-related skills, qualifications, and experience, in adherence to equal employment opportunity principles and applicable laws. Reasonable accommodations are provided during the recruitment process upon request.

c5b95b3620d5a92a.description: About the Role Mace Group is seeking an Associate Project Director to provide project management consultancy services for a major mixed-use development in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This part-time position involves supporting the delivery of a significant new-build residential development, overseeing the project lifecycle from design through construction and handover. The role requires a minimum of 10 years of experience, with a strong focus on front-end, design, and development expertise alongside proven construction delivery capabilities. Key Responsibilities Oversee end-to-end project management and delivery of major new-build residential assets from concept design through pre-contract, procurement, construction, commissioning, and handover. Establish robust project governance, controls, reporting, and decision-making processes from early design stages. Take ownership of the overall project program, with a particular focus on establishing, controlling, and maintaining the design program. Provide early project management oversight across development and design functions, ensuring development objectives translate into clear and deliverable project requirements. Coordinate with PMC design managers, architects, design consultants, specialist consultants, and the wider multidisciplinary project team to achieve design deliverables against key milestones. Challenge design progress, identify program risks, and drive consultants and stakeholders toward timely decisions and resolution. Manage the integration of design, approvals, procurement, and construction programs to maintain a clear route to delivery. Support and coordinate the project's residential sales launch strategy, ensuring critical design and delivery milestones support required commercial launch dates. Supervise the fast-track delivery of the sales center, managing interfaces between design, procurement, approvals, and construction to achieve an accelerated program, followed by the delivery of high-end residential apartment buildings. Develop and maintain the project execution plan, master program, risk register, governance structure, and project reporting requirements. Manage procurement strategy and contractor appointment activities, ensuring appropriate consideration of packaging, sequencing, program, and project risk. Transition the project effectively from pre-contract into construction and maintain continuity of project leadership throughout delivery. Manage consultants, contractors, and specialist suppliers while driving accountability against program, cost, quality, and contractual requirements. Monitor project performance, identify emerging risks, and implement recovery or mitigation measures where required. Provide clear, concise reporting to senior stakeholders on program, design, commercial matters, risks, decisions, and delivery status. Maintain stakeholder relationships and foster strong collaboration between development, design, commercial, procurement, and construction teams. Maintain strong project management discipline throughout delivery while ensuring Mace's safety, quality, and governance requirements are achieved. Qualifications and Experience Relevant project management and construction industry experience, with significant experience in senior project leadership positions. Demonstrable experience successfully delivering large-scale new-build residential developments of comparable size and complexity, ideally more than one major residential project. Strong evidence of managing residential projects across the complete lifecycle from early design/pre-contract through procurement, construction, and handover. Significant front-end and design management experience, with the ability to establish control of complex design programs and drive multidisciplinary design teams against demanding milestones. Strong understanding of residential development requirements and the relationship between development strategy, design, sales and marketing milestones, procurement, and physical delivery. Proven ability to manage and coordinate with architects, designers, engineering consultants, cost consultants, contractors, and specialist stakeholders within complex project environments. Strong program management skills with experience identifying program risk, challenging consultant performance, and implementing recovery strategies. Demonstrable procurement, contract, commercial, risk, and change-management experience. Strong client-facing and senior stakeholder-management capability, including the confidence to operate effectively within a high-profile project subject to significant executive scrutiny. Experience delivering major projects within a PMC, client-side, or development-management environment. A degree in construction management, engineering, architecture, project management, or a related discipline. Professional membership such as RICS, CIOB, APM, or equivalent would be advantageous. Previous experience delivering major residential developments in Saudi Arabia or the wider Middle East would be advantageous. Work Type This is a part-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Application Process Candidates who meet the outlined qualifications are encouraged to apply.

c5a4cd278da6a4a1.description: About the Role Halliburton is seeking a Field Professional to join our team in Al Qatif or Al Khobar. Apply engineering, mechanical, and geological principles to articulate basic data interpretations to clients using proprietary software. Learn to guide clients through various drilling scenarios. c53bea177cc45a20.description: About FlyAkeed: FlyAkeed is an online platform that helps people book flights and hotels easily. We started in 2017 and are based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. Our travel solution simplifies the process of planning and handling work-related travel. Highlights: Current funding stage: Series A FlyAkeed is supported by: PIF subsidiary Sanabil Investments, Elm, Artal Capital, Alrajhi Partners. We are currently looking for a Product Designer Specialist to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will leverage your design expertise to enhance our user experience across our mobile and web platforms. You will collaborate with product managers and engineers to create user-centered designs that not only meet but exceed user expectations. Your creative vision and attention to detail will play a critical role in shaping the future of travel booking experiences for our customers. Responsibilities Design and prototype user-centered interfaces for mobile and web applications. Conduct user research and usability testing. Create wireframes, user flows, and high-fidelity mockups. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including product management, engineering, and marketing to align design with business goals. Maintain design consistency across all platforms by contributing to the development of design systems and style guides. Stay informed on industry trends and best practices to continuously enhance design quality. c5a44239757acb5b.description: About Maarif Education Maarif Education is seeking an Islamic Studies Teacher to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves active participation in curriculum development and continuous professional growth. Key Responsibilities Review and evaluate personal teaching and learning strategies, methodologies, and programs in alignment with curriculum standards and framework guidelines. Participate in the preparation and development of courses of study, subject scope and sequence, teaching materials, teaching programs, methods of teaching and assessment, and all school plans and programs. Engage in reciprocal peer review and observation of classroom teaching practice by the subject supervisor or Head of Learning. Participate in in-service education and training courses, as well as continuing professional development (CPD) opportunities. Contribute to the professional development of new teachers according to arrangements agreed upon by the school authority. Provide necessary information, data, plans, and documents to designated school personnel, including details regarding requisitions and arrangements related to areas of responsibility. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of relevant teaching experience. Demonstrated ability to educate, inspire, and motivate students. Commitment to continuous professional development. Work Environment This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within an educational setting that values professional growth and collaborative teaching practices.

c5a7ec873d714d3f.description: About the Role Leylaty Group is seeking an experienced Head Chef specializing in French and Italian Mediterranean Cuisine to lead all kitchen operations. This full-time role is based in Jiddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia, and involves overseeing culinary standards, managing kitchen staff, and ensuring the preparation and presentation of high-quality dishes. The Head Chef will play a key role in menu development, kitchen management, and maintaining the highest standards of food quality, safety, and hygiene. Key Responsibilities Lead, plan, develop, and execute menus with a focus on authentic French or Italian Mediterranean cuisine. Oversee all kitchen operations to ensure efficient workflow and smooth daily activities. Supervise and manage kitchen staff, including Sous Chefs, Chef de Partie, Commis Chefs, and other team members. Ensure proper food preparation, cooking techniques, portion control, and presentation standards. Maintain exceptional food quality, taste, consistency, and culinary standards aligned with the restaurant's brand. Develop new dishes, seasonal menus, and culinary concepts while preserving authenticity and creativity. Manage food costs, budgets, inventory, purchasing, and supplier relationships to maximize profitability and minimize waste. Establish and enforce food safety, health, hygiene, and sanitation standards across all kitchen areas. Recruit, train, mentor, and evaluate kitchen staff to maintain a skilled and motivated team. Prepare staff schedules, allocate responsibilities, and manage kitchen staffing requirements. Monitor kitchen performance and implement procedures to improve efficiency, productivity, and food quality. Handle customer feedback, special dietary requirements, and food-related complaints when necessary. Coordinate with restaurant management and front-of-house teams to ensure excellent guest experiences. Maintain a positive, disciplined, and professional kitchen environment. Ensure all kitchen equipment is properly maintained and operational. Qualifications and Experience Proven experience of 10+ years as a Head Chef or Executive Chef in a reputable restaurant or similar hospitality establishment. Strong hands-on experience in French or Italian Mediterranean cuisine is mandatory. A culinary degree or equivalent professional certification is preferred. Extensive knowledge of culinary techniques, menu development, food presentation, and kitchen management. In-depth knowledge of food safety, hygiene, and sanitation regulations. Required Skills Strong leadership, communication, and team management skills. Proven ability to manage food costs, inventory, purchasing, and kitchen budgets. Ability to work under pressure and manage a fast-paced, high-volume kitchen. Creativity, attention to detail, and a strong passion for French and Italian Mediterranean culinary arts. Excellent organizational, decision-making, and problem-solving skills. Work Type This is a full-time position within Leylaty Group, based in Jiddah, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. Application Process We invite qualified candidates to apply for this Head Chef position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

c55863faf8d466fd.description: About the Role Nokia is seeking a Regional Technology Specialist – Mission Critical & Enterprise for the Middle East and Africa (MEA) region. This full-time role is a key part of the Mission Critical & Enterprise (MC-E) Technology Strategy team, reporting to the Segment Technology Lead. The specialist acts as a bridge between global technology strategy, domain expertise, and customer-facing Sales and Pre-Sales organizations across MEA. Role Context and Scope The position requires broad technological understanding across the MC-E segment's mission-critical domains, including energy and utilities, transportation and rail, public sector and defense, and research and education. The Regional Technology Specialist will identify common technology requirements, architectural patterns, operational challenges, and emerging trends across these industries, translating them into relevant solutions for regional customers. This involves complementing deep vertical expertise with an end-to-end technology and architecture perspective, connecting customer needs with appropriate technologies and solutions from the portfolio. Key Responsibilities Partner with Sales and Pre-Sales teams to support opportunity qualification, solution architecture, and technical positioning across Mission Critical & Enterprise domains. Lead customer discovery sessions, architecture workshops, technical presentations, executive briefings, and competitive discussions. Support RFI/RFP responses, solution demonstrations, proof-of-concept planning, and strategic pursuits. Translate customer business and technology requirements into compelling solution architectures and value propositions. Gather and analyze customer, partner, market, and competitive insights, converting findings into actionable recommendations. Contribute to technology strategy by developing business cases, supporting roadmap discussions, and providing market-driven requirements. Act as a liaison between regional teams and global technology strategy functions, communicating portfolio direction, best practices, and technology updates. Provide competitive intelligence, field-readiness input, and technical enablement assets to strengthen customer engagement and drive growth across the region. Strategic Engagement and Collaboration A significant aspect of this role involves supporting strategic customer engagements across MEA. This includes collaborating with account teams during opportunity development, participating in customer workshops, shaping solution architectures, and providing guidance during complex pursuits. The specialist will also identify when deeper involvement from MC-E domain experts, product teams, or other technology specialists is required and facilitate their engagement. The role also serves as a two-way connection, bringing global technology strategy into MEA customer engagements while feeding regional customer requirements and market insights back to the broader MCE Technology Strategy organization. Required Experience 5-10 years of experience in a relevant technology or solutions role. Demonstrated understanding of mission-critical domains such as energy, utilities, transportation, public sector, and defense. Experience in translating complex technology concepts into customer-centric solutions and value propositions. Role Objectives Through regional engagement, horizontal technology expertise, and close collaboration with domain specialists, the Regional Technology Specialist aims to strengthen the technical capabilities of the MEA field organization. The ultimate objective is to enable Sales and Pre-Sales teams to engage customers earlier and more strategically, develop robust solution architectures, accelerate complex opportunities, and effectively position the MC-E portfolio across the region’s mission-critical markets.

c56d2f0529c0efaf.description: About the Role Al Tuwairqi Group is seeking a Foreman, Stores to manage store operations in Jeddah. c553d2d450896953.description: The Quality Control Engineer is responsible for inspecting, monitoring, and ensuring the quality of all finishing, interior fit-out, natural stone, and marble installation works in accordance with approved shop drawings, project specifications, material submittals, method statements, and applicable quality standards. The role requires strong technical expertise in architectural finishes, high-end interior fit-out, stone and marble fabrication and installation, ensuring that all works meet the required standards of workmanship, dimensional accuracy, alignment, levelness, joint consistency, surface finish, and overall aesthetic quality. The QC Engineer shall coordinate with site engineers, subcontractors, consultants, suppliers, and project management teams to identify quality issues, prevent defects, and ensure that all completed works comply with project requirements before handover. Key Responsibilities 1. Finishing and Interior Fit-Out Quality Control Inspect all architectural finishing and interior fit-out activities, including flooring, wall cladding, ceilings, gypsum works, painting, tiling, joinery, doors, decorative finishes, and other interior works. Ensure all executed works comply with approved shop drawings, technical specifications, material approvals, and project quality requirements. Verify dimensions, levels, alignment, verticality, surface flatness, edge details, and finishing quality. Inspect interfaces between different finishing materials to ensure proper coordination, clean transitions, and high-quality workmanship. Conduct site inspections at each stage of work to identify defects before subsequent activities proceed. 2. Stone and Marble Quality Control Perform detailed inspections of natural stone and marble materials, including marble, granite, limestone, travertine, and other decorative stone finishes. Verify material type, color, veining, texture, thickness, dimensions, finish, and overall consistency against approved samples and material submittals. Inspect stone and marble slabs, tiles, and fabricated pieces for cracks, chips, scratches, stains, discoloration, edge damage, and other visual or dimensional defects. Verify slab selection, vein matching, bookmatching, grain direction, color consistency, and layout patterns in accordance with approved drawings and samples. Inspect stone fabrication, cutting, edge profiling, mitre joints, corner details, openings, cut-outs, and polishing quality. Monitor stone and marble installation, ensuring correct setting-out, alignment, levelness, joint width, lippage control, fixing systems, adhesive application, and anchoring methods. Verify substrate preparation, waterproofing where applicable, backing supports, mechanical fixing systems, and installation methods according to approved details and manufacturer recommendations. Inspect grouting, joint filling, sealant application, staining protection, cleaning, polishing, and final finishing. Ensure proper handling, transportation, storage, and protection of stone and marble materials to prevent damage before and after installation. Identify and report unacceptable workmanship, material defects, and installation deviations, and ensure corrective actions are completed. 3. Inspection and Quality Documentation Prepare and submit Inspection Requests (IRs/WIRs) and coordinate inspections with the consultant and client representatives. Review approved shop drawings, material submittals, method statements, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), and project specifications before work execution. Maintain inspection records, checklists, material inspection reports, non-conformance reports (NCRs), and quality documentation. Raise Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs) for defective or non-compliant works and follow up on corrective and preventive actions. Verify that corrective works have been completed satisfactorily before requesting reinspection. Maintain photographic records of site inspections, defects, corrective actions, and completed works. Support the preparation of snag lists, de-snagging inspections, and final handover documentation. 4. Site Coordination and Quality Assurance Coordinate with site engineers, finishing engineers, subcontractors, stone suppliers, fabrication workshops, consultants, and project management teams. Review and inspect mock-ups and sample installations before approving or recommending approval for mass production and installation. Monitor workmanship during execution and provide technical guidance to prevent recurring quality defects. Ensure materials and workmanship are consistent with approved samples, design intent, project specifications, and client expectations. Participate in quality meetings, progress inspections, and technical coordination meetings. Ensure completed works are properly protected against damage caused by subsequent construction activities. Monitor compliance with approved quality procedures, relevant standards, and project-specific requirements. 5. Final Inspection and Handover Conduct final quality inspections of completed finishing, fit-out, stone, and marble works. Verify uniformity of finishes, joint consistency, alignment, surface condition, cleanliness, and overall visual appearance. Identify and document defects, incomplete works, and deviations from approved requirements. Follow up on snagging and de-snagging activities until all quality issues are resolved. Ensure proper cleaning, sealing, polishing, protection, and maintenance requirements are completed before handover. Assist in compiling quality records and handover documents. Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Architectural Engineering, or a related field. Minimum 3–5 years of experience in construction quality control, preferably in finishing, interior fit-out, and high-end architectural projects. Strong hands-on experience in natural stone and marble fabrication, installation, inspection, and finishing. Practical knowledge of marble and stone flooring, wall cladding, countertops, staircases, vanity tops, decorative stone features, and custom stonework. Good understanding of architectural drawings, shop drawings, material specifications, method statements, and installation details. Experience in preparing inspection requests, quality checklists, NCRs, and inspection reports. Familiarity with ISO 9001 quality management principles and project-specific QA/QC procedures. Proficiency in reading construction drawings and using AutoCAD and Microsoft Office is preferred. Strong communication, coordination, problem-solving, and reporting skills. A

c589cf2011d9cece.description: Role Summary The Quality Inspector – Electrical is responsible for monitoring and ensuring all electrical installations and testing activities comply with approved project specifications, electrical codes, quality procedures, and inspection requirements. The role involves daily site inspections, identifying non-conformances, reviewing contractor submissions, and ensuring that all electrical works meet the project's quality objectives. The inspector works closely with the QC Manager, electrical engineers, and contractors to maintain high-quality execution across all electrical systems. Key Responsibilities Conduct daily site surveillances to ensure electrical works are progressing according to approved ITPs, checklists, and specifications. Identify deficiencies, faults, and non-compliance issues related to electrical works and report them immediately to the QC Manager for corrective action. Close all electrical WIRs and MIRs after verifying that all required documentation and approvals from relevant discipline engineers are complete. Review and understand electrical specifications, drawings, PQP, ITPs, method statements, QC procedures, and other related quality documents. Witness testing and inspection of electrical systems and materials (e.g., cables, switchgear, grounding, conduits, panels) and complete associated forms per approved procedures. Monitor and review contractor practices related to electrical quality and safety to ensure compliance with project requirements. Conduct daily coordination meetings with the contractor’s QC representative to ensure full understanding of electrical quality management procedures. Assist the construction team with resolving electrical quality issues and technical challenges. Support the Quality Manager (QM) in preparing and executing quality audits related to electrical work. Prepare daily QC reports and submit them to the QC Manager no later than 9:00 AM the following day. Verify that all electrical testing tools and measuring devices have valid calibration certificates. Review and maintain logs of electrical WIRs, MIRs, MARs, NCRs, and other quality documentation. Report any discipline-related miscoordination affecting electrical systems to the Resident Engineer (RE) and Quality Manager (QM). Qualifications & Requirements 5–10 years of relevant experience, preferably within a Project Management Consultancy (PMC) environment. Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Electrical Engineering or a related field. Strong understanding of electrical systems, installations, testing, and commissioning. Familiarity with international electrical codes and standards. Excellent attention to detail with strong documentation and reporting skills. Ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, technical specifications, and method statements. Strong communication skills and a proactive approach to resolving quality issues.
